revenue.note: Booked base sales value (excluding tax) from sales orders. If question specifically asks for invoiced/tax-inclusive revenue or billing, use proforma.grand_total.

invoiced_revenue.note: Invoiced total amount including GST and discounts from proforma invoices.

tax_amount.note: Total GST tax amount from proforma invoices.

stock_quantity.note: stock.qty is VARCHAR — CAST before aggregating.

customer.note: party table holds both customers (profile_type='Party') and suppliers (profile_type='Company').

quotation.note: Price estimates, proposals, and quotations sent to customers.

purchase_quantity.note: Quantity of raw materials or stock purchased from suppliers.

transporter.note: Logistics carrier or transport company used for dispatch.

lead_inquiry.note: Sales inquiries and potential client leads.

opening_balance.note: Initial starting balance for customers or suppliers.

stock_adjustment.note: Authoritative table for stock adjustments (transaction_type='StockOut' or 'StockIn'). Never use stock or product_packaging_detail.

financial_year_current_year.note: Allowed values: 'N', 'Y'. Values are 'Y' (current fiscal year) and 'N'. ONLY filter financial_year.current_year = 'Y' when user explicitly requests current/this year data; DO NOT filter by current_year for cumulative or all-time queries.

lead_status.note: Allowed values: 'Success', 'Pending', 'Reject', 'In-Progress'. Actual status values in database are 'Pending' (104 rows), 'In-Progress' (2 rows), 'Success' (119 rows), 'Reject' (21 rows). Open/active leads are status IN ('Pending', 'In-Progress').

lead_next_followup_date.note: Use for sales leads and inquiries pending follow-up.

packagings_qty.note: Authoritative product unit quantity inside carton boxes. For total carton quantity in a warehouse or product, use SUM(packagings.qty). Do NOT use COUNT(*), which only counts box rows.

party_status.note: Allowed values: 'Y', '', 'N'. Values are 'Y' (active) and 'N' (inactive). Active parties: party.status = 'Y'.

sales_order_so_due_date.note: Authoritative due date for sales orders and delivery challans (via delivery_challan.sales_order_id = sales_order.id)

stock_carton_verify_status.note: Values are 'P' (Pending / unverified) and 'V' (Verified). Pending/unverified cartons: carton_verify_status = 'P'. Verified: carton_verify_status = 'V'.

stock_qty.note: stock.qty is stored as VARCHAR — ALWAYS CAST to DECIMAL or UNSIGNED when doing SUM, AVG, or numeric comparisons.

stock_status.note: Values are 'B' (Booked / available in-stock on hand) and 'D' (Dispatched / shipped out). Available stock on hand: stock.status = 'B'.

stock_adjustment_transaction_type.note: Exact enum values: 'StockOut' (stock reduction) and 'StockIn' (stock addition). NEVER use 'OUT' or 'IN'!

stock_adjustment_category_id.note: Foreign key to category.id. Links adjustment to category (e.g. 'Carton', 'Raw Material').

stock_adjustment_product_id.note: Foreign key to product.id. Links adjustment to product name.

stock_adjustment_qty.note: Adjusted stock quantity. To get total adjusted quantity, use SUM(stock_adjustment.qty).

warehouse_location_name.note: Warehouse facility name or number (e.g. '110', 'Main Warehouse'). Linked to packagings via packagings.warehouse_id = warehouse.id.

warehouse_warehouse_code.note: Authoritative warehouse code (e.g. 'pm2bzd19'). Match warehouse codes here, NOT in packagings.location_code! Linked to packagings via packagings.warehouse_id = warehouse.id.
